text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated KMS API latency and 5xx rates observed for GCP KMS (us-west2). Multiple hosts failing to complete startup signing. Paging oncall.

oncall: @aj you have the pager — high-priority, startup failures across infra pool A (service: signer).

maria: Confirming — I'm seeing ~30% of new instances fail in the last 6m with `sign` timeouts. Logs show `rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed` during KMS calls.

aj: I'm on it. Checking KMS metrics and recent deploys. No deploys to signer in the last hour.

sam: From infra side, control-plane is fine. This looks like an external dependency. Can we confirm which KMS endpoint is hit (regional vs global)?

maria: Services are using regional endpoint `us-west2-kms.googleapis.com`. Latency heatmap from our tracing shows tails > 10s and increased 503s.

aj: Opening cloud support case now. Case: GCPCS-202303-8745 (will update with owned support link once created). Meanwhile: mitigation options - client-side caching of keys, aggressive retries with jitter, or switching to fallback signing path.

sam: Recommend enabling client-side ephemeral key cache + reduce instance restart churn. If VMs are restarting and hammering KMS during boot, we need to slow down restarts.

maria: Pushing emergency flag to reduce auto-restarts and enable cache. Patch to deployment rollout:

```sh
# reduce restart loops and enable cache
kubectl set env deploy/signer ENABLE_KMS_CLIENT_CACHE=true
kubectl patch ds signer -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"terminationGracePeriodSeconds": 120}}}}'
kubectl scale deployment signer --replicas=30
```

aj: Also throttling the autoscaler to prevent rapid scale-ups:

```yaml
autoscaler:
  scaleDownDelay: 300s
  maxBurst: 2
```

maria: Done. Flipped ENABLE_KMS_CLIENT_CACHE=true in signer. Observability shows client cache hits starting to appear (cache-hit-rate 0 -> ~40% in 2m).

zoe: Support & CS: Are customers seeing errors? I can already see increased 500s on the public inference API (from NewRelic): about ~1.8% error rate, spike started ~06:12 UTC.

maria: Correct. Root-cause: signing retries are failing during startup flows which causes request preparation to fail and surfaces as 502/500 at the API edge. We're mitigating but customer impact exists.

aj: Cloud provider updated support case: they're seeing a regional anomaly in us-west2 KMS for ~18m. They're routing to engineering. ETA unknown. They've suggested using cached keys or a regional failover.

sam: Temp fallback plan we pushed: signer will attempt local cached key signed tokens for up to 60s if KMS fails, then fail open for non-critical infra flows. We added stricter verification for long-lived tokens before expiry.

maria: Quick note on change control — this is an emergency flag (no code change). I'll document the rollout in #eng-releases after we stabilize.

aj: For transparency, summary metrics while we work:
- KMS 5xx rate: peaked 12% at 06:18 UTC
- Host startup signing failures: ~32% of new boots between 06:12-06:25
- Customer-facing 5xx rate on inference API: 1.8% peak

zoe: I'll draft a short customer-facing status note for impacted tenants. Ask: do we have a list of affected regions/customers? We can map request regions to KMS region and send targeted messages.

maria: I have a query to pull affected tenant ids; running now. Will share in a follow-up message.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied: ENABLE_KMS_CLIENT_CACHE=true across signer pool. Autoscaler throttled. Cloud support case GCPCS-202303-8745 linked. Continue monitoring.

aj: Monitoring traces and SLOs. If error rate doesn't drop under 0.3% within 30m, we'll escalate to a cross-functional bridge with Product and Legal.

sam: Also set a temporary limit on instance restarts in the cluster to avoid cascading KMS load. We'll roll this back once the KMS anomaly clears.

maria: Next steps: 1) continue monitoring 2) finish affected tenant list and send status via support 3) schedule post-incident review focusing on client caching and startup backoff patterns.

zoe: Drafted customer note, will post after maria confirms tenant list. Suggest adding a short KB on our KMS client-side caching strategy.

aj: Cloud provider just replied: they're routing traffic away from a subset of KMS frontends, should see improvement in 5-10m. Keeping the page open.

maria: Seeing latency tail drop now, KMS 5xx down to ~2%. Host startup failure rate dropping to ~6% as cache ramps.

zoe: Good, I'll hold announcement for 15m until stable. If anything changes, ping the channel.

maria: Thanks everyone. Will start a short postmortem doc and link it here once we have logs + timeline.

(reactions: :thumbsup: from aj, :pray: from zoe)
